data.body: **P1 — Recheck scope fatals after invocation-end dispatch.** A blocked `onInvocationEnd` can overlap the handler owner's scope close after the pre-dispatch check. If that close reports a `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath`, this method never checks `scopeFatal` again, so `execute()` can return PENDING/RETRYING despite the fatal occurring before the end hook returned. Recheck `scopeFatal` after this try-with-resources block without rerunning hooks, and update the late-fatal test to require the caller to receive the original fatal.
